summary.id: Detail kaca dari referensi pemilik: kartu lembut, pil persentase & tooltip kaca bersemu warna, progress tebal bergaris. Eksplorasi warna merek dihapus. Klik pertama di Studio kini berhasil.
summary.en: Glass details from the owner reference: soft cards, tinted glass percentage pills & tooltips, thick striped progress. Brand colour exploration removed. First Studio click now works.

title.id: Kartu lembut: selisih +3 L* dari latar
title.en: Soft cards: +3 L* step above the background

detail.id: Terang #F8F8F8 di atas #F0F0F0, gelap #171718 di atas #0A0A0B — langkah kecerahan yang sama dengan referensi; tepi = garis bayangan 1 px + sorotan 1 px.
detail.en: Light #F8F8F8 on #F0F0F0, dark #171718 on #0A0A0B — the same perceptual step as the reference; edge = 1 px shadow line + 1 px highlight.

title.id: Pil persentase kaca bersemu warna metrik
title.en: Glass percentage pill tinted by the metric colour

detail.id: Angka warna teks, segitiga hijau/merah; tepi kiri & bayangan bersemu warna yang sama. Chip status di daftar pekerjaan memakai resep yang sama.
detail.en: Text-coloured number, green/red triangle; left edge & shadow tinted with the same colour. Status chips in the work lists use the same recipe.

detail.id: Batang 14 px bergaris diagonal hijau dengan penanda di ujung; arahkan kursor untuk “75,6% · Rp 75.000.000 dibayarkan”. Nominal ringkas di kartu metrik juga menampilkan angka lengkap saat diarahkan.
detail.en: 14 px bar with green diagonal stripes and an end marker; hover for “75.6% · Rp 75,000,000 paid”. Abbreviated metric values also reveal the full number on hover.

title.id: Klik pertama di Studio kini berhasil

detail.id: Titik pulih Studio (8,5 MB) melebihi kuota localStorage sehingga skenario pertama selalu gagal diam-diam — kini cukup disimpan di memori.
detail.en: The Studio checkpoint (8.5 MB) exceeded the localStorage quota so the first scenario always failed silently — it is now kept in memory.

summary.id: Masukan dev 3: kartu metrik ringkas dengan rincian buka/tutup, preview jauh lebih cepat, entri tema gelap di Studio diperbaiki.
summary.en: dev 3 feedback: compact metric cards with expandable details, much faster preview, Studio dark-theme entry fixed.

title.id: Rincian metrik buka/tutup di bawah kartu
title.en: Metric details expand below the cards

detail.id: Klik kartu untuk membuka perbandingan periode (tanpa popup). Kartu 20% lebih pendek; nominal besar diringkas (Rp 151,6 jt).
detail.en: Click a card to expand the period comparison (no popup). Cards are 20% shorter; large amounts are abbreviated.

title.id: Preview lebih cepat, tanpa perjalanan versi

detail.id: Tampil 12,8 → 8,8 dtk (kunjungan ulang 9,8 → 6,2 dtk); setiap gambar ulang 467 → 189 ms. Judul tab & label versi tidak lagi berganti saat memuat.
detail.en: Shows in 8.8 s instead of 12.8 s (repeat visits 6.2 s); each re-render 189 ms instead of 467 ms. Tab title and version label no longer cycle while loading.

summary.id: Fondasi tampilan baru, diuji di Dashboard Super & Admin: font Geist, skala tulisan tanpa tebal, tema gelap lebih pekat, persentase metrik sebaris.
summary.en: New look foundation, trialled on the Super & Admin dashboards: Geist font, weight-light type scale, deeper dark theme, inline metric percentages.

detail.id: 7 ukuran (12–40) dengan berat 400/500 saja; penekanan lewat ukuran & warna. Font 18 KB. Baru di Dashboard.
detail.en: 7 sizes (12–40), weights 400/500 only; emphasis through size and colour. 18 KB font. Dashboard only for now.

detail.id: Latar #0A0A0B, kartu #141415 bertepi tipis — berlaku di seluruh halaman tema gelap.
detail.en: Background #0A0A0B, cards #141415 with a hairline border — applies to every dark-theme page.

detail.id: +12% ↗ hijau, −8,1% ↘ merah, 0% → abu-abu; keterangan periode tetap di bawah.
detail.en: +12% ↗ green, −8.1% ↘ red, 0% → grey; the period caption stays below.

summary.id: Preview lebih ringan: berkas besar dimuat belakangan.
summary.en: Lighter preview: large files load later.

detail.id: Data bank/wilayah dan pembuat PDF kontrak (1,4 MB) diunduh setelah tampilan muncul; tampil ±15% lebih cepat di jaringan HP.
detail.en: Bank/region data and the contract PDF maker (1.4 MB) download after the screen appears; about 15% faster on mobile networks.

summary.id: Titik awal v1.1: audit keamanan & uang, ikon verifikasi baru, data contoh disamarkan.
summary.en: v1.1 starting point: security & money audit, new verification badge, pseudonymised sample data.

detail.id: Bintang datar 11 ujung sesuai referensi; centang transparan mengikuti warna latar.
detail.en: Flat 11-point star per the reference; the check is transparent and shows the background.

detail.id: Nama label, artis, email, WA dan alamat asli diganti samaran; nominal dan status tetap.
detail.en: Real label, artist, email, phone and address values are replaced; amounts and statuses are kept.

title.en: Preview opens without the version run-through

detail.id: Tampilan muncul sekali dalam kondisi akhir; label versi kini v1.1 · dev N.
detail.en: The screen appears once in its final state; the version label is now v1.1 · dev N.

title.id: Pembayaran token tidak lagi melunasi add-on
title.en: Token payments no longer settle add-ons

detail.id: Invoice berisi add-on dibayar rupiah; token hanya untuk biaya rilisan.
detail.en: Invoices with add-ons are paid in rupiah; tokens cover the release fee only.

detail.id: Klik ganda tidak memotong token dua kali, tidak ada refund ganda, withdraw yang sudah dibayar tidak bisa ditolak ulang.
detail.en: Double clicks never spend twice, no double refunds, paid withdrawals cannot be rejected again.

detail.id: Keluar akun berfungsi saat pratinjau; menu khusus Super Admin tersembunyi selama pratinjau.
detail.en: Sign-out works during preview; Super Admin-only menus stay hidden while previewing.
